plain_language_rule: source or receipt timestamp must be row-level, not capture-only
available_to_brain_ts must be no later than the decision timestamp
raw_path must exist and raw_sha256 must match
ticker/entity mapping must pass ambiguity and collision checks
source links and headlines must support the mapped entity or macro bucket
market data used for replay must be independently as-of certified
no future outcome, future price, or future source row may be used for assignment
owner must approve a separate trading-feature admission task
